_doc: Level bar across the high line: arm forward, finger up (joints), wrist rolled 90 so the jaw swings sideways, jaw fully open so the sword sticks out horizontally. pan centres the bar on the opponent's chop (37 puts the chop mid-bar). t_move, t_hold.

_help.joints.wrist: wrist pitch (deg): -94 = finger pointing straight up
_help.pan: base rotation centring the bar on the opponent's chop (deg): 37 = chop hits mid-bar; less = bar more sideways but off-centre
_help.roll: wrist roll: 90 = jaw swings sideways so the open sword is a level bar
_help.jaw: jaw opening: 100 = sword fully out sideways
_help.captured.end: pose captured from the arm (real degrees). Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
